x: This race, held before our Senior 5¾ mile road race, proved to be a great success, with a run-away win for Stephen Walters in a time that represents 5:24 miling for the 1 mile 760 yard course.
On May 7th at Crystal Palace, during a Southern Counties A.A.A. open meeting, Toby Staff and Steve Walters had a rare old dust-up in the Youths 1500 metres.

Ivan Beaumont (a Boy) and Steve Walters (a Youth) also fancied their chances and took on the Seniors, putting up a couple of quite respectable performances and neither of them a long way down on the senior standard.

"Right, who's next" - Some of the Belgrave lads stand prepared to take on all-comers. Left to right: Gary Budinger, S.Watts, Mark Shippen, Robert Bashford, Steve Walters, Gary Wallace, David Didino and Ivan Beaumont.
This years recipients - Toby Staff and Stephen Walters.

All our boys seemed to find the heavy going more than they bargained for but perhaps Stevie Walters, with just that little more experience of running than the others was the least affected as he led our Youth team in.
